name: Venomancer: Poison for Everyone and Limb Decayer change native cost and cast time (#1934, #2226)
contract: #1934 and #2226 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two passives that are plain spell modifiers (aura 107/108, SpellFamilyName 35) read straight from Spell.dbc. #1934: Poison for Everyone! (504837) effect 0 is aura 107 SPELLMOD_COST, BasePoints -101 DieSides 1 (-100, rage tenths, tooltip 'by $/10;s1' = 10 rage), class mask (0,0,0x800000) = Venomtip Poison 803195 (PowerType rage, ManaCost 200, no ManaCostPercentage), so its native cost goes 200 -> 100. #2226: Limb Decayer (681057) effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME BasePoints -51 (-50%) and effect 1 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST BasePoints 49 (+50%), both class mask (0,0,0x8) = Decay 800910 (cast index 19 = 2500 ms, ManaCost 100 plus 25% of create mana), so its cast time goes 2500 -> 1250 and its cost is multiplied by 1.5. Each modifier must leave the other spell untouched, which the masks guarantee and the scenario asserts. Values are the server's own SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost, CalcCastTime and ApplySpellMod, measured before and after learning on the same actor.
